d:
Anant Singh Supreme Court : bihar ke mokama vidhayak anant sinh ke lie aaj yani 30 aktubar ka din aham hai. dularchand yadav hatyakand men patna haeekort se mili jamanat ko radd karne ki mang vali yachika par suprim kort men sunvaee honi hai.
Dularchand yadav ke pote niraj kumar ne suprim kort men yachika dakhil kar anant sinh ki jamanat radd karne aur unhen dobara jel bhejne ki mang ki hai. anant sinh ko 19 march 2026 ko patna haeekort se jamanat mili thi. ab suprim kort men is yachika par hone vali sunvaee par sabhi ki najren tiki hain.
